items.recapEn: The walk's first real snow fell on Kameyama and cleared to blue over the castle's white turret wall. Hana wrote the end of the road's long middle in two voices, formal and casual. They returned Hori-san's umbrella to Nakajima-san, who gave them hot amazake; a kindness tick. Tanaka-san had predicted no snow; they meet him in Seki for New Year.

items.recapEn: In the snow below Kameyama Castle, Hana and Ken agreed it does snow after all, just not in July at Kanbara, and that the castle's white wall had been white before the snow. Ken's noodle count reached sixty-four. At Nakajima-san's shop they returned Hori-san's umbrella, drank hot amazake, and left with a bottle that made Ken's pack 'lighter'.
